messages:
Maya Chen: Quick heads-up — planning an SDK upgrade to 11.0.0 next Tue 10:00am PT. This is a non-breaking bump for most clients but there are two notable changes we need owners for: a minor API param rename and a config parsing tweak. Need smoke owners, e2e signoffs, and a rollback owner.
Zain Patel: I can take smoke for server-side SDKs. What are the exact changes?
Maya Chen: Thanks Zain. Two items: 1) parameter `timeout_ms` is now `timeout` (we kept backwards compat shim but deprecated). 2) config v2 accepts a list for `model_overrides` instead of a single string, which changes implicit merging behavior.
Priya Rao: I can run client-side quick tests (node/python). Do we have a test matrix?
Maya Chen: Minimal test matrix: node (12/14), python (3.9/3.11), go (1.20). Smoke checklist: init + auth + single-gen + streaming + embeddings.
Luca Bianchi: For rollback ownership I can handle releases and registry pinning. If rollback needed, we should pin users to 10.4.1 and redeploy routing within 20min.
Grace Kim: I'll draft the client-comms blurb. TL;DR: auto-shim keeps old param but logs deprecation; recommend client teams switch before end of Q2.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment window created: 2026-03-24 17:00 UTC -> 2026-03-24 17:30 UTC (ID: rwd-deploy-6821).
Zain Patel: Question on telemetry: do we want a quick metric to detect increased 5xx after config change?
Maya Chen: Yes — add a golden metric: SDK API 5xx rate by version and a latency P95. If 5xx spike >0.2% absolute within 30m, auto-roll back.
Priya Rao: I'll add smoke scripts to repo/testmatrix and ping @Zain when done. Quick note: streaming protocol test occasionally flakes — I'll isolate that.
Luca Bianchi: Rollback steps (short): 1) pin model-serving routes to v10.4.1 2) revert SDK artifact tag 3) run smoke quick-suite 4) notify client teams. I have runbook ready in /runbooks/sdk-rollbacks.
Grace Kim: Draft comms: "Heads-up: SDK v11 will be deployed Tue 10am PT. No breaking changes but note deprecation of `timeout_ms`. Auto-shim included; please migrate by 2026-06-30." I'll post to #developers and send email to integrators.
Maya Chen: Final checklist before go: smoke owners assigned (Zain/Priya), rollback owner (Luca), comms (Grace), metrics/alerts (Zain), can we confirm all by EOD Friday?
Zain Patel: Confirmed — metrics alert + smoke scripts by EOD Fri.
Priya Rao: Confirmed — client smoke scripts + flaky streaming test isolation by EOD Fri.
Luca Bianchi: Confirmed rollback runbook and permissions.
Grace Kim: Confirmed comms draft will be in #announcements by EOD Fri.
Maya Chen: Great — I'll schedule the deploy and add canary at 10% for 15 minutes, then 50% for 10 minutes if healthy. Thanks everyone :party_parrot:
